data.body: **[P1] Do not re-export terminal child contexts during replay.** This guard only deduplicates within one invocation and is cleared by `_reset_state()`. ReplayChildren contexts emit `on_child_context_end(..., is_replayed=True)` on every replay, so each invocation exports another span with the same deterministic trace/span ID; collectors may overwrite or reject the original span. Ignore replayed terminal callbacks or otherwise persist export state across invocations, and add a two-invocation ReplayChildren test asserting one context span.
